name: io.github.csacanam/hashproof
description: Issue verifiable credentials (diplomas, certificates, badges) from any AI agent for $0.10 USDC via x402 or an API key. Registered on-chain on Celo, pinned to IPFS, verifiable by anyone via QR.

environmentVariables.name: HASHPROOF_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Prepaid API key (alternative to wallet). One of the two payment methods is required only for issue_credential.

environmentVariables.name: HASHPROOF_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM private key of a dedicated wallet holding USDC on Base or Celo — pays $0.10 per issuance via x402.
